content.name: Natalie Koh
content.title: People and Culture Manager
content.summary: Senior HR professional (CAHRI) with 14 years in retail, higher education and construction. Leads a team of four supporting 1,400 employees under three enterprise agreements, and resolved a historical underpayment of award entitlements affecting 600 staff.

experience.title: People and Culture Manager
bullets: Lead a four-person HR team supporting 1,400 site and office employees covered by three enterprise agreements.
Led bargaining for a new enterprise agreement with unions, approved by the Fair Work Commission without industrial action.
Rolled out a psychosocial hazard risk assessment in line with Victorian OHS duties, with actions tracked by every site manager.
Reduced voluntary turnover among project engineers from 24% to 15% through clearer career levels and pay bands.
Partner with the executive team on workforce planning for a $1.3 billion project pipeline.

experience.title: Senior HR Advisor
bullets: Advised faculty heads on academic and professional staff matters under the university enterprise agreement.
Reviewed 600 casual staff payments against award entitlements and coordinated back-payments of $2.1 million.
Ran 25 formal workplace investigations and trained managers on procedural fairness.
Redesigned the probation process, cutting late probation reviews by 70%.

experience.title: HR Advisor
bullets: Supported 38 homewares stores with employee relations, recruitment and roster compliance under the General Retail Industry Award.
Delivered workplace behaviour training to 400 store team members.
Handled WorkSafe claims and return-to-work plans for warehouse and store staff.

experience.title: HR Officer
bullets: Processed onboarding, contracts and terminations for about 900 employees.
Coordinated police checks and Working with Children Checks where required.
Maintained the HR information system and produced monthly headcount reports.

achievements.title: Enterprise agreement approved
achievements.detail: Bargaining led at Yarra Civil Constructions without industrial action.

achievements.title: $2.1 million back-payment
achievements.detail: Award compliance review for 600 casual staff at Merri Creek University.

interests: Volunteer at a migrant resource centre
